logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 20's cliffhanger where Catherine and Rupert plotted to seize Ashbury upon the Dowager Duchess's demise; in the village, Juliana puts aside her grief over her burned cottage to save young Toby, stumbling upon critical intelligence regarding the manor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lady Juliana in a rustic grey gown, her wrists wrapped in white bandages, smoothing a blanket over a straw pallet in the dimly lit barn.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana gently straightens the grey wool blanket over the hay bed, exhaling a soft, exhausted sigh.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot framing the open doorway against the overcast daylight as Prudence, a young village girl in an apron, rushes inside, frantic and weeping.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Desperate, Panicked)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Urgent)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Breathless)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Inquiring, Strained)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Anguished, Resentful)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Bitter, Tearful)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Sorrowful, Dejected)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: We have no clinic now.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Despondent)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Pleading, Desperate)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Authoritative)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking wide shot following Lady Juliana and Prudence running side by side along a muddy, puddled village road past thatched stone cottages under a gloomy, overcast sky.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of seven-year-old Toby lying on a makeshift straw pallet before a roaring fireplace, coughing weakly.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Alarmed, Focused)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: His skin is burning hot.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Commanding)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Hurried, Obedient)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Yes! Right away, I will get it!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Introspective, Determined)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Instructive, Calm)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Tearful, Coaxing)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Encouraging, Reassuring)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Overwhelmed, Relieved)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Caring)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Grateful, Choked with Emotion)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Fervent, Devoted)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Warm, Sincere)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Indignant, Resentful)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Ominous)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: But their gold cannot buy them health.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Startled, Curious)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Solemn, O.S.)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: She is dying, Lady Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Prudence leaning in close to Lady Juliana, whispering with grave intensity.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Conspiratorial, Grim)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Dark, Chilling)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Brief cut back to Toby sleeping peacefully on his straw pillow by the warm fireplace.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana sits motionless at the rustic wooden table, her bandaged hands holding open her late mother's leather-bound herbal ledger. Her eyes reflect deep apprehension as the dire truth settles over her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow push-in on Lady Juliana staring down at the ancient pages, her expression filled with profound realization and growing resolve as dramatic strings swell to a gripping cliffhanger.
